mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate environment, as indicated by FEDFUNDS below 1.0%, compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in GDP and housing starts (GDPC1 and HOUST) indicates robust aggregate demand, which accelerates corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (both GDPC1 and HOUST rising) fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of industrial production growth (INDPRO above 100), manufacturing output expansion supports corporate profit margins, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is above 100, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1200.0 thousand units signals weak residential construction, which reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST is below 1200.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 245.0) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 1.0%) indicates a period where the central bank is not tightening despite inflation, which supports equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 245.0 and FEDFUNDS < 1.0%, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In the context of a low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.5%), strong labor market conditions support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 4.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the CPI index above 245.0 indicates persistent inflation, which typically triggers central bank tightening and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 245.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.
